messages:
emma: Heads up — opened PR to change auth token refresh flow for onprem/VPC. Needs security review before we merge to main. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821
raj: taking a look now. main concerns?
emma: Mainly secret handling in the agent bootstrap and the k8s service account scope reduction. Diff focused in src/agent/bootstrap.go and infra/k8s/role.yaml
sec-bot: Automated secret-scan results: 1 issue flagged — ephemeral token logged in bootstrap.go:78. See scan details: https://sec.internal/scan/4821
lucas: I pushed a small patch to remove the token logging and redact debug output. Can follow up on SA scope after a quick sec check.
privacy: quick flag — onprem customers need an entry in the deployment docs about token rotation and who runs the KMS keys for private installs. I'll add a short note.
raj: thanks. For the SA scope change, are we limiting to namespace-only and token projection? need to confirm no cluster-wide perms.
emma: yes — namespace-only, gather configmaps + projected token. No clusterRole bindings anymore.
lucas: updated infra/k8s/role.yaml to drop clusterroles and only grant get/list on configmaps in the app namespace. PTAL @raj @privacy
sec-bot: Security checklist: service account scope reduced — please confirm acceptance. Ticket SEC-2047 created.
raj: scanning the diffs now. The SA change looks correct. Two small asks: 1) add unit test ensuring role.yaml doesn't contain clusterrole, 2) update ops-runbook to mention fallback tag.
emma: will add both. fallback tag is image:v2.14.1 (we'll keep that in the canary runbook).
sam: for rollout planning — do we want to canary this to Dedicated/us-west first or straight to prod onprem?
lucas: canary to Dedicated/us-west for 1 hour, smoke tests (auth, inference, metrics) — if green, then schedule main rollout. Safer for onprem customers.
privacy: docs updated in the PR description. wording: "rotation owner must rotate keys and update projection config". OK from privacy side.
raj: +1 on canary. I approve SEC-2047 content and role changes. leaving formal LGTM here. :white_check_mark:
emma: thanks — scheduling canary now (ETA 14:30 PST). I'll post results.
lucas: pushed the unit test and ops-runbook update to the branch.
sec-bot: Canary started on Dedicated/us-west for pr/4821 at 2026-03-17T14:30:00Z. Monitoring enabled.
emma: canary passed (1h). No errors in metrics or logs. proceeding to merge window.
lucas: merging branch to main now, will tag release and update deploy pipelines.
emma: PR merged to main after successful canary. Release notes: "Reduce SA scope for agent; remove token logging; docs & runbook updates"
sam: great work. please notify customer ops about onprem change and attach the runbook. If any customer impact, we run the fallback tag.
privacy: noted and notified customer-privacy team.
emma: closing thread — thanks all.
